title: Crypto Bodyguard
tagline: A Dapp where you can hire bodyguard and pay them with Crypto
description:
Going outside can be unsafe.  Hire a bodyguard to protect you.  You can pay them with Crypto. You can also DM bodyguard and see map of available bodyguards.

In the future, I can add zero knowledge to do KYC on the bodyguard. I will add stake feature where for bodyguard to stake in order to be added to the bodygruard list.
how_its_made:
I built the front end with Next.js and bootstrap 5 for styling.  I built the contract with truffle.  I deploy my contract on Skale, Optimism, and Rinkeby Testnet.

I used the following technologies:
 Skale - I deployed the contract on Skale Testnet for cheap gas fee 
NFT Port - To free mint and send thank you card as NFT to the Bodyguard
Pocket Network - deploy contract on Rinkeby Testnet using Pocket Network as an RPC provider
Optimism - I deployed the contract on Optimistic Kovan  Testnet for cheap gas fee
XMTP - For private messaging between user and bodyguard Ethereum accounts
Valist- Published Website on Valist.io => https://app.valist.io/songweb3/cryptobodyguard
